summary: Completed full backend and frontend testing for Areas 1-4 of AutoLenis: Dealer Auth, Dealer Applications, Admin User Creation, Admin Dealer Invitations, Dealer Invite Claim, Dealer Onboarding, Admin Inventory Search Tool. 56/56 backend tests pass (100%). All UI flows verified via Playwright with cookie injection.

minor.issue: After server restart, Turbopack was serving a stale Prisma client that did not have dealerApplication/dealerInvitation models — resolved by restarting frontend supervisor. All endpoints work correctly after restart.

issues: Next.js dev toolbar shows '1 issue' notification at bottom-left — likely a dev-mode TypeScript or next-devtools warning. Not visible in production build. No actionable impact.

critical_code_review_comments: AREA 1 Dealer Signin: Works correctly — POST /api/dealer/auth/signin sets httpOnly dealer_token cookie, returns dealerId and success. Wrong creds return 401 with correct error message.

AREA 1 Dealer Application: POST /api/public/dealer-application creates DealerApplication with status PENDING. Duplicate email (existing PENDING) correctly returns 409 DUPLICATE_APPLICATION. Validation errors return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

AREA 1 Dealer Onboarding: PATCH /api/dealer/onboarding correctly steps BUSINESS_INFO→LICENSE→INVENTORY→AGREEMENT. Requires dealer_token cookie (correctly returns 401 without it). AGREEMENT step would set dealer.status=ACTIVE (not tested directly to avoid overwriting test dealer state).

AREA 2 Admin Create Users: POST /api/admin/users/create works for BUYER/DEALER/AFFILIATE. Admin-created dealers are immediately ACTIVE (vs application-created PENDING). Affiliates get auto-generated referral code (AL + 6 chars). requiresPasswordChange=true set for all created users.

AREA 3 Admin Invite Dealers: POST /api/admin/dealers/invite returns token+inviteUrl in response. GET /api/admin/dealers/invitations lists correctly. Cancel/Resend actions work. Resend returns new inviteUrl.

AREA 3 Dealer Invite Claim: GET validates token (404 for invalid, 410 for accepted). POST creates User+Dealer and sets dealer_token cookie. Claimed dealer has status=PENDING (correct — needs onboarding). Duplicate claim → 409.

AREA 4 Inventory Search Tool: Falls back to internal DB when MARKETCHECK_API_KEY absent (confirmed 'Internal DB' source badge). Returns 14 Toyota results. Add vehicle creates InventoryItem with sourceAdapter=manual_admin, lane=LANE_1, price in cents. Duplicate VIN → 409.

Missing test coverage: Admin approve-application flow NOT tested with real data (creates Supabase user — hard to clean up). The reject flow was tested instead. Approve handler exists and 404 for nonexistent IDs is confirmed.
The '1 issue' notification badge in admin pages appears to be from Next.js dev tools (Turbopack dev mode) — not an application bug, not visible in production.

seed_data_creation: Test data created during this run (all cleaned up in module teardown): buyer TEST_buyer_{ts}@, dealer TEST_dealer_{ts}@, affiliate TEST_aff_{ts}@, invitation TEST_invite_{ts}@, inventory VIN TEST-VIN-{ts}, dealer application TEST_dealerapp_{ts}@. Claim test user (TEST_claim_{ts}@) also created and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 areas implemented and tested end-to-end. JWT forgery pattern: admin_token uses issuer='autolenis-admin', dealer_token uses issuer='autolenis-dealer' — both with JWT_SECRET. Cookie injection works for both admin and dealer SSR pages (proxy.ts checks only JWT, no Supabase session required). Admin dealers page has 3 tabs (data-testid: tab-dealers, tab-applications, tab-invitations). Search tool submit is data-testid='search-submit' (not btn-run-search). Affiliate form uses add-aff-* prefixes (not add-affiliate-*). One known gap: approve-application flow not tested with real data (rejection tested instead). 'Turbopack stale Prisma client' issue resolved by server restart — monitor if it recurs after code changes.
rca_of_turbopack_issue: Root cause: When Prisma schema was updated (adding DealerApplication, DealerInvitation, requiresPasswordChange etc.) and Prisma client was regenerated, the running Next.js Turbopack dev server still had a cached bundle of the old Prisma client in memory. The database tables existed and Prisma client had the new models, but the live server module cache didn't reflect this. Fix: sudo supervisorctl restart frontend. Prevention: Always restart frontend after Prisma schema changes.
